title: SealedRecord
description: Written once by the Seal, never updated. This is what /r/<id> renders and what a stranger checks.

id.description: Opaque and unguessable. It is a public URL.

public.description: True only for anon and demo tenants. Real tenant records are private with an explicit share action.

ceiling_unreachable.description: Each with the one-line reason it is out of reach at this tier. This is the call to action, and it is honest.

deficiencies.description: What the Gate reads. A deficiency against a field required at this strictness holds the machine.

machine_released.description: The Gate's answer. Deterministic, from deficiencies and strictness.
